prose: The New York Times reports Microsoft employees, used to stability, are grappling with the company's offer of buyouts to 60,000 people as AI spending grows. Within an hour of the announcement last week, staff rushed to an internal site to see whether they were eligible.
highlights: Offer comes as AI spending grows
Employees unsettled by the break from stability
basis: Error cache: NYT paywall. Written from the Techmeme headline and lede.
